contradictions.english: The winner then bows, and the one who is not the winner ascends to take the cup and drink.
contradictions.why: The source says the winner bows and the loser ascends to take the cup; the English implies the winner bows while the loser ascends, but the source text does not specify the winner bows while the loser ascends to drink as a sequence of two separate actions, but rather describes the ritual procedure of the loser taking the cup.
